name: luismc-docs
description: The documentation standard for every project, to DOCSPEC: the docs/ layout by reader question (overview, features, design-system, architecture, guides, reference, project), a feature-spec template with front matter, a generated offline docs/index.html with search and a feature index by app and topic, one version per release folded from change notes, checks that keep docs true to the code (links, Source: lines, code-to-doc map, freshness, generated reference), a scripted move for existing repos, a guard that keeps agent briefs and reports off the default branch, and Stop and SessionStart hooks that remind the agent. Generic: nothing project-specific.
